label: Weather and Nature
heading: Egyptian Arabic Weather and Nature — 29 Words

examples.arabic: القط بتاعك بياكل الورد بتاعي كل يوم
examples.english: Your cat eats my flowers every day!
examples.transliteration: El ott beta'ek byakl el ward beta'y kol youm!

examples.arabic: الجو كان جميل أوي الصبح في حتتنا.
examples.english: The weather was very beautiful this morning in our neighborhood.
examples.transliteration: El gaw kan gameel awi el sobh fi 7atetna.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: امبارح الجو كان حلو بس النهارده كل حاجة برد
examples.english: Yesterday the weather was nice but today everything is cold.
examples.transliteration: Embareh el gaw kan helw bas ennaharda kol haga bard.

examples.arabic: الجو مطر النهاردة
examples.english: The weather is rainy today.
examples.transliteration: El gawa matar naharda.

examples.arabic: أحمد قال لصاحبه علي: الجو هنا جميل أوي النهاردة.
examples.english: Ahmed said to his friend Ali: The atmosphere here is very beautiful today.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed al le sahbo Ali: El gaw hena gamil awi ennaharda.

examples.arabic: أنا حسيت إن قلبي بيتنطط من السعادة في وسط الجو الجديد ده.
examples.english: I felt that my heart was jumping from happiness in the middle of this new atmosphere.
examples.transliteration: Ana hasset en alby beyetnattat men el saada fi wast el gaw el gedid da.

examples.arabic: ابويا حضن اخويا جامد والجو الدافي ملى الصالة
examples.english: My dad hugged my brother tightly and the warm atmosphere filled the living room.
examples.transliteration: abouya hadan akhouya gamed wel gaw el dafy mala el sala
examples.storyTitle: The National Team Match with the Family

examples.arabic: عمر بيحب البحر وهو فرحان قوي

examples.transliteration: Omar beyheb el baher wa howa farhan awy

examples.arabic: ماما بتحب البحر اوي
examples.english: Mom loves the sea very much.
examples.transliteration: Mama betheb el bahr awi.

examples.arabic: عيلتي هتاكل سمك على البحر
examples.english: My family will eat fish by the sea.

examples.english: Suddenly she saw Marwa standing next to an old silver shop, "Marwa! Here I am! How are you, my darling, how are you doing in this heat?" Mona called out to her joyfully.
